brief:
Israeli occupation forces shot a young man with live ammunition and arrested him Sunday evening near the town of al-Taybeh, east of Ramallah, Shehab Wire reported. The incident occurred in the area surrounding the Palestinian town located in the central West Bank.

Details of the shooting remain limited. The condition of the detainee and the specific circumstances that preceded the arrest have not been disclosed.
